title: CallStateEnum
description:
* `connecting` - The remote party is being alerted.
 * `alerting` - The user's devices are alerting for the incoming or Click to Dial call.
 * `connected` - The call is connected.
 * `held` - The user has placed the call on hold.
 * `remoteHeld` - The remote party within the same organization has placed the call on hold.
 * `disconnected` - The call has been disconnected.
